collection.scope: Current models and sampled retired models: 30 new development answers/cell. Remaining references: matched prior raw observations; no held answers fitted.
collection.historical_provenance_note: Prior observations preserve their original source approvals, including accepted empty-system/period equivalence; not all historical observations are newly collected OpenRouter data.

development.meaning: Preassigned 30 development answers per newly collected cell.

result.scope: 10 fresh held answers/cell; 10000 empirical bootstrap paths/source. Initial fitting and lines frozen before opening. Business policy and GPT medium other margin finalized after inspection; not independent population accuracy.

validation.legacy_contract_note: Raw symmetric counts are preserved. GPT quick-tier legacy envelope is 70% correct and 12% any-path error across ALL sources (including old Luna); it is NOT the current-model target. Separate directional gates above retain 97% current-model quick target and 99% medium/high targets. The old-Luna/new-Luna exception does not relabel errors as correct.
validation.transport_validation: Inherited native-protocol empirical results; no fresh Chat protocol observations.
